minimal_documentation_text: The masked-owned semantic 4 candidate (contract 8) passed 446/446 decode cases under interleaved-v1 timing on a PRO 6000 Server (188 SMs): 56 slices, six confirmations, 458 phases, 916 two-sided records, 31,560 raw latency samples. Initial-ratio geomean 0.7318103372125201, per-case maximum-phase geomean 0.7318186491252202 and worst phase 0.990327380952381; all phases meet <=1.01. Source used b12x base 56c00e61 plus dirty and declared untracked inputs; the harness root was also dirty. Neither recorded source identity nor a later commit proves an exact clean measurement revision. This is decode only: do not combine with the earlier semantic 3 prefill/decode 819 as a same-source 819 result. Case memory peaks include both sides and preparation/oracle/timing, not b12x workspace.
